confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use current Cluj-Napoca price aggregates, which postdate the July 2026 pricing window and serve as a nearby proxy. Cocktail uses menu aggregates; wine by the glass is estimated from its local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation is a broad seasonal model estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Cluj-Napoca-specific aggregates. Accommodation is benchmarked broadly against mid-sized Central and Eastern European university and tourism cities.
